name: July 2026 Heavy Monsoon Replay
description: 104 mm rainfall over 24 hours. Post-upgrade pump deployment kept Minto Bridge & Dhaula Kuan open.
actual_outcome: All major hotspots remained functional due to pre-positioned 754 permanent & 305 temporary pumps.

name: May 2025 Cloudburst Event Replay
description: 85 mm severe cloudburst over 3 hours overnight. Legacy pump capacity caused Minto Bridge & Zakhira underpasses to flood.
actual_outcome: Minto Bridge closed for 4.5 hours; Zakhira closed for 3.2 hours due to drain clogging and delayed pump dispatch.
